        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",

        "\n",
        "pd.set_option(\"display.max_columns\", None)\n",
        "sns.set_theme(style=\"whitegrid\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Public dataset\n",

        "\n",
        "df = pd.read_csv(url)\n",

      "source": [
        "# Convert date and time fields\n",
        "df[\"Date\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Date\"], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "df[\"Time\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"Time\"], format=\"%H:%M\", errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"Hour\"] = df[\"Time\"].dt.hour\n",
        "df[\"Day\"] = df[\"Date\"].dt.day_name()\n",
        "df[\"Month\"] = df[\"Date\"].dt.to_period(\"M\").astype(str)\n",
        "\n",
        "df.head()\n"

      "source": [
        "day_order = [\"Monday\",\"Tuesday\",\"Wednesday\",\"Thursday\",\"Friday\",\"Saturday\",\"Sunday\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "day_sales = df.groupby(\"Day\")[\"Total\"].sum().reindex(day_order)\n",
        "display(day_sales.to_frame(\"Total Sales\"))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(9,5))\n",
        "sns.barplot(x=day_sales.index, y=day_sales.values)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sales by Day of Week\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Day\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Total Sales\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=30)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ]
    },

          "output_type": "stream",

          "text": [
            "Peak sales hour: 19\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "hour_sales = df.groupby(\"Hour\")[\"Total\"].sum()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))\n",
        "sns.lineplot(x=hour_sales.index, y=hour_sales.values, marker=\"o\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Sales by Hour\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Hour\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Total Sales\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Peak sales hour:\", hour_sales.idxmax())\n"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "features = [\"Unit price\", \"Quantity\", \"Total\", \"Rating\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "X = df[features].copy()\n",
        "\n",
        "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        "X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "scores = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "for k in range(2, 7):\n",
        "    model = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "    labels = model.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "    scores[k] = silhouette_score(X_scaled, labels)\n",
        "\n",
        "score_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Number_of_Clusters\": list(scores.keys()),\n",
        "    \"Silhouette_Score\": list(scores.values())\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "display(score_df)\n"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "best_k = max(scores, key=scores.get)\n",
        "\n",
        "kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=best_k, random_state=42, n_init=10)\n",
        "df[\"Cluster\"] = kmeans.fit_predict(X_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Selected number of clusters:\", best_k)\n",
        "\n",
        "cluster_profile = df.groupby(\"Cluster\").agg(\n",
        "    Transactions=(\"Invoice ID\", \"count\"),\n",
        "    Average_Unit_Price=(\"Unit price\", \"mean\"),\n",
        "    Average_Quantity=(\"Quantity\", \"mean\"),\n",
        "    Average_Total=(\"Total\", \"mean\"),\n",
        "    Average_Rating=(\"Rating\", \"mean\")\n",
        ").round(2)\n",
        "\n",
        "display(cluster_profile)\n"
      ]
    },
